paragraphs.text: Miara , is a daen , an elven packmaster of the Exquisite caste on the plane of Lorwyn .

Miara leads a hunting pack and has the esteemed privilege of being allowed to speak to elves of the Perfect caste . While her skills as a deadly hunter and talented tactician earned her the notice of elven leadership, it was her ruthless and thorough extermination of eyeblights that made her Exquisite. The most silent hunter on the plane, Miara's prey never sees nor hears her coming.
